thread:
alex: Heads up — acme-inc reports a big throughput regression on our hosted endpoint when payloads hit ~6-8k input tokens. p50 ok, but p95 jumped from ~180ms -> ~1.5s at concurrency ~40. Need a repro pack (curl + promptset + concurrency profile + request IDs) so eng-runtime can reproduce.

maria: Which model/variant are they using? quantized? any topology info?

alex: model=redwood-medium-8k, quant=4bit, region=us-west-2. Customer says this started after our runtime change last week.

sam: I pulled the customer logs and found these request IDs. Two representative requests: 01F3A9B2 and 01F3A9D7. Logs show a long stall at kv-cache miss path. Snippet:
```
[2026-03-11T09:12:21.123Z] req=01F3A9B2 model=redwood-medium-8k tokens_in=6724 tokens_out=128 p50=210ms p95=1482ms stage=kv_fetch miss=true
[2026-03-11T09:12:22.270Z] req=01F3A9D7 model=redwood-medium-8k tokens_in=6100 tokens_out=90  p50=195ms p95=1370ms stage=kv_apply
```

jordan: I'll assemble a promptset for the repro. Plan: 6 prompts — small (100t), medium (1k), large (4k), edge (6-8k), streaming test, system-heavy. Will include exact token counts and expected outputs.

maria: Can you post curl that reproduces one of the slow calls? I'll try locally.

sam: Use this curl, it includes x-request-id header to keep traceable:
```
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "x-request-id: 01F3A9B2" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-medium-8k","input":"<long prompt here>","max_tokens":256}'
```

support-bot: To collect a debug bundle from a customer session, run the support collector and provide the request IDs. Command: `/collect-debug 01F3A9B2 01F3A9D7 --include=metrics,profiles,kv-traces` — upload link will be returned.

jordan: Promptset (first two examples inline) — I'll attach the rest in the repo but pasting a couple:
```
# 1 small
"Summarize: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."  // tokens ~9
# 4 edge-large
"<~6200 token user prompt comprised of repeated paragraph blocks>"  // tokens ~6200
```

alex: Concurrency profile we want run in eng: ramp 1 -> 50 over 2min, hold at 50 for 3min, then ramp down. Batch size suggestions: 8 and 16. Customer observed regressions at concurrency 30-50.

sam: Also include token distribution file (CSV) with counts per prompt. Example rows: `prompt_id, tokens_in, expected_p95_baseline_ms` -> `edge-large,6200,180`

maria: Baseline numbers (before change): p50=160ms, p95=180ms at concurrency=40. Observed (after): p50=200-220ms, p95=1.2-1.6s.

alex: Can SRE run the repro pack in staging with the same model/quant flags? If we can reproduce, we can bisect the runtime change. Assigning eng-runtime to validate.

jordan: I uploaded the promptset + token CSV to the support folder (link: internal only). Also included two curl scripts: `repro_ramp.sh` and `repro_hold.sh`.

sam: One more note: include a streaming vs non-streaming comparison. We saw streaming mode reduces p95 by ~30% in some runs. Could hint at batching behavior.

alex: Thanks everyone — I'll convert this into a single repro pack tarball (promptset.jsonl, token_counts.csv, concurrency.yaml, curl scripts, debug_bundle_link) and drop in /eng/runtime/incoming. SRE please run the profile by EOD.

maria: I ran a quick local run against staging (ramp=10->30) and reproduced p95 ~1.1s on the edge-large prompt. Dropping raw timings in the support folder. :raising_hand:

alex: Great — assigning to @sam for logs correlation and @jordan to finalize promptset. Will update thread when eng-runtime starts bisect.

support-bot: debug bundle uploaded: https://internal.storage/debug/01F3-debug-bundle-177250.zip (expires in 7 days).

alex: Closing loop for now — thanks. If anyone finds more request IDs or synthetic failures, paste them here and we'll append to the pack.
